title: Quarantine new plants and seed stock
category: Food growing · Pest and disease control
subcategory: Quarantine new plants and seed stock
summary: Prevent imported pests and disease from entering the main garden.
steps: Buy or exchange only legally permitted, labelled plant material from a traceable source.
Inspect roots, stems, leaf undersides and growing medium before bringing material near established crops.
Keep new live plants separately for an observation period appropriate to the risk.
Use separate tools and avoid runoff from quarantine into the main area.
Destroy or report suspicious regulated pests according to official plant-health instructions rather than distributing the material.
